scientific_integrity: Complete enumerations and executable independent implementations; no claim of externally independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-field classification of bidegree-(4,4) filling divisors on P1xP1 over F2. Counts embedded equivalence under 72 rational surface automorphisms, not abstract curve isomorphisms. Geometric smoothness verified by exact Groebner algorithms; possible unindexed prior classifications remain a priority risk.
title: A complete orbit census of smooth binary filling curves of bidegree \(4,4\)
